claims.text: Split archive inventories Administration ≠ maritime links

Split’s archive inventories describe Venetian municipal offices and a French-period first-instance court operating from 1 January 1807, after 1806 rules. These are local administrative witnesses, not merely treaty recipients. They do not establish whether particular maritime connections ended or persisted; that needs different evidence.
Does evidence of a new Split court show every maritime connection changed? It shows a local institution; sea-route continuity needs different evidence
